summary: Disclose how the organization identifies, assesses and manages climate-related risks. Investors and other stakeholders need to understand how climate-related risks are identified, assessed and managed, and whether those processes are integrated into existing risk management processes.

disclosures.title: Describe the organization's processes for identifying and assessing climate-related risks.

questions.text: What are your risk management processes for identifying and assessing climate-related risks, and how do you determine the relative significance of climate-related risks in relation to other risks?
Do you consider existing and emerging regulatory requirements related to climate change (e.g. limits on emissions), and other relevant factors, when assessing climate-related risks?
questions.hint: Guidance for All Sectors. Describe which requirements and factors are considered.

questions.text: What processes do you use to assess the potential size and scope of identified climate-related risks?
What risk terminology do you use, or which existing risk classification frameworks do you refer to?
questions.hint: Guidance for All Sectors (consider disclosing): definitions of risk terminology used or references to existing risk classification frameworks.

disclosures.title: Describe the organization's processes for managing climate-related risks.

questions.text: How do you decide whether to mitigate, transfer, accept or control climate-related risks?
questions.hint: Guidance for All Sectors: processes for managing climate-related risks, including how decisions to mitigate, transfer, accept or control risks are made.

questions.text: How do you prioritize climate-related risks, including how materiality determinations are made within your organization?
Do your management processes address the risks listed in the TCFD's Tables A1 and A2 (policy and legal, technology, market, reputation, acute and chronic physical risks), as appropriate?
questions.hint: Guidance for All Sectors. Describe how each is addressed.

disclosures.title: Describe how processes for identifying, assessing, and managing climate-related risks are integrated into the organization's overall risk management.

questions.text: How are your processes for identifying, assessing and managing climate-related risks integrated into your overall risk management?
